name: Break & hold (follow) at VWAP ± 2 standard deviations with order flow
why: A first 5-minute close beyond VWAP ± 2 standard deviations with aggressive flow behind it is real demand running the stops parked there; the triggered stops add fuel in the same direction. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md).

scan.when: flow && vsd > 0 && ((cl(5,1) > lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd) && lag(5, cl(5,1)) <= lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd) && dsum(5,1) >= a*vsum(5,1)) || (cl(5,1) < lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd) && lag(5, cl(5,1)) >= lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd) && dsum(5,1) <= -a*vsum(5,1)))
scan.dir: (cl(5,1) > lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd) && lag(5, cl(5,1)) <= lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd) && dsum(5,1) >= a*vsum(5,1)) - (cl(5,1) < lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd) && lag(5, cl(5,1)) >= lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd) && dsum(5,1) <= -a*vsum(5,1))
